verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships versioned npm packages, with a probe recording @babylonjs/core at 9.26.1. Community users praise its strong backward compatibility, unlike Three.js. However, no first-party documented deprecation policy appears anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, deprecation timelines or semver guarantees, and first-party docs on API versioning or migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: ThreeJS's API breaks backwards compatibility a lot, while Babylon is exactly the opposite.
the documentation and backwards compatibility is quite something
